Failure mode: pleasant enough to coast on and never deepen. Take the opening - make the move, plan the date - instead of waiting for it to escalate on its own.

summaryShort: The attraction is there, but it usually needs someone to do something with it. Venus and Mars support each other here, so charm and desire can work well together, but the chemistry may not fully open unless someone makes a move.
summaryDeep:
The attraction is there, but it usually needs someone to do something with it. Venus and Mars support each other here, so charm and desire can work well together, but the chemistry may not fully open unless someone makes a move.

This can start in a subtle way. A little flirting, a little effort, a little willingness to show interest. The more both people participate, the more the attraction has somewhere to go.

Failure mode: leaving the spark sitting there because everyone is waiting for it to become obvious on its own.

Reach for it. This aspect opens when someone acts.
